segments.tr: *Este artículo es solo para información general y no constituye asesoramiento financiero, fiscal o legal.*

ar.title: إعادة ضبط قروض الطلاب: كيف تغير قواعد السداد الجديدة الفواتير الشهرية لملايين المقترضين

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: يممر سداد قروض الطلاب الفدرالية بأكبر عملية إعادة صياغة له منذ سنوات.

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: قام الكونغرس بتغيير القواعد في قانون المصالحة لعام 2025، وتعمل وزارة التعليم على تنفيذ تلك التغييرات تدريجياً.

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: إن خطط السداد الجديدة، وحدود الاقتراض الجديدة، والقائمة المتقلصة من الخيارات المستندة إلى الدخل تعني أن المبلغ الذي يدين به العديد من الخريجين كل شهر قد يبدو مختلفاً عما خططوا له.

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا الدليل من يتأثر، وما الذي يجب التحقق منه في حساب جهة خدم القروض الخاصة بك، وكيف يمكن أن تنعكس التغييرات على ميزانيات الأسر والائتمان.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة مالية أو قانونية.

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتغير الجداول الزمنية والتفاصيل مع اللوائح الجديدة والأحكام القضائية، لذا تأكد من التفاصيل على موقع StudentAid.gov أو مع جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك.

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## الصورة الكبيرة

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: هناك ثلاثة تحولات هي الأهم:

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **خطة جديدة تعتمد على الدخل.** خطة المساعدة في السداد (RAP) متاحة للمقترضين بدءاً من 1 يوليو 2026.

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **مجموعة أصغر من الخطط بمرور الوقت.** يتم التخلص التدريجي من عدة خطط حالية تعتمد على الدخل.

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **حدود اقتراض جديدة.** تُطبق الحدود المفروضة على المبلغ الذي يمكن للطلاب وآبائهم اقتراضه على القروض الجديدة التي يتم الحصول عليها في أو بعد 1 يوليو 2026.

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## خطة المساعدة في السداد (RAP)

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: تربط خطة RAP دفعتك الشهرية بإجمالي دخلك المعدل (AGI) بدلاً من نسبة من الدخل التقديري.

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: بناءً على الهيكل المنشور للقانون:

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - تتراوح المدفوعات تقريباً بين 1% إلى 10% من إجمالي الدخل المعدل (AGI)، وترتفع مع زيادة الدخل.

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - يوجد حد أدنى للدفع الشهري قدره $10.

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - يتم تخفيض الدفع بمقدار $50 شهرياً لكل طفل معال.

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - إذا لم تغطِ دفعتك الفائدة الشهرية، يتم إسقاط الفائدة غير المدفوعة. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تطابق الخطة تخفيض أصل القرض، حتى $50 شهرياً، عندما تكون دفعتك صغيرة.

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - قد يتم الإعفاء من الأرصدة المتبقية بعد 30 عاماً من المدفوعات المؤهلة.

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعديد من المقترضين ذوي الدخل المنخفض والمتوسط، يمكن أن تنتج خطة RAP فاتورة أقل أو أكثر قابلية للتوقع من الجدول الزمني القياسي.

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: قد يدفع أصحاب الدخل المرتفع أكثر مما يدفعونه بموجب بعض الخطط القديمة المستندة إلى الدخل.

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن المعادلة تستخدم إجمالي الدخل المعدل (AGI)، فقد تتصرف بشكل مختلف عن الخطط التي قد تكون معتاداً عليها.

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: استخدم محاكي القروض الرسمي بدلاً من التخمين.

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## ما يحدث للخطط القديمة

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: الخطط التي كانت موجودة قبل التغيير توجد على مواعيد نهائية مختلفة:

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE.** لقد تورطت هذه الخطة في دعاوى قضائية وتم وضع العديد من المقترضين المسجلين فيها في فترة سماح. بموجب القانون الجديد، يتم إنهاؤها تدريجياً. إذا كنت مشتركاً في SAVE، ترقب الإشعارات حول اختيار خطة جديدة.

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYE و ICR.** من المقرر إغلاق هذه الخطط أمام التسجيل الجديد، ويحدد القانون الموعد النهائي في 1 يوليو 2028 للمقترضين الحاليين للانتقال إلى خطة أخرى. قد يتم وضع المقترضين الذين لا يختارون خطة في خطة تحددها الوزارة.

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR.** يظل السداد القائم على الدخل متاحاً للمقترضين الحاليين، مما يجعله خياراً مهماً للأشخاص الذين يغادرون الخطط الأخرى.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **السداد القياسي.** من المتوقع أن تحتوي القروض الجديدة المقدمة بعد 1 يوليو 2026 على خطة قياسية مدتها تختلف حسب الرصيد، بالإضافة إلى خطة RAP.

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: تحقق من خطة خدمة القروض التي تظهر لك اليوم، ثم قارنها بما ستكون مؤهلاً له.

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي تغيير الخطط إلى تغيير فاتورتك الشهرية وعدد السنوات حتى الإعفاء.

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## حدود الاقتراض الجديدة

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: بالنسبة للقروض الجديدة المقدمة في أو بعد 1 يوليو 2026، الحدود الرئيسية هي:

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: هناك أيضاً حد أقصى مدى الحياة قدره $257,500 للاقتراض الفدرالي لكل شخص (باستثناء قروض Parent PLUS).

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: لم تعد قروض Grad PLUS متاحة للمقترضين الجدد.

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: قد يتمتع الطلاب المسجلون بالفعل والذين يقترضون قبل الموعد النهائي بفترة انتقالية مدتها بضع سنوات، لذا تحقق من كيفية التعامل مع وضعك الخاص.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى أكثر مما تسمح به الحدود قد يلجأون إلى القروض الخاصة، والتي عادة ما تفتقر إلى السداد المستند إلى الدخل، أو خيارات الإعفاء، أو نفس حمايات الصعوبات المالية.

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: هذا المقايضة تستحق النظر فيها قبل الاقتراض.

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## مسارات الإعفاء

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **الإعفاء من قروض الخدمة العامة (PSLF).** يظل برنامج PSLF سارياً للمقترضين العاملين لدى الجهات الحكومية وغير الربحية المؤهلة، وعادةً بعد 120 دفعة مؤهلة. من المتوقع أن تُحتسب المدفوعات بموجب خطة RAP. حافظ على تحديث شهادة جهة عملك.

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **الإعفاء المستند إلى الدخل.** قد يتم الإعفاء من الأرصدة المتبقية بعد فترة الخطة (20 إلى 30 عاماً حسب الخطة). بدءاً من عام 2026، تُعامل المبالغ المعفاة بموجب هذه الخطط عموماً كدخل خاضع للضريبة مرة أخرى على المستوى الفدرالي، ما لم يُطبق استثناء. خطط لهذا الاحتمال بدلاً من افتراض أن الرصيد يختفي ببساطة.

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **الإبراءات.** تظل إبراءات الإعاقة الكلية والدائمة وغيرها من الإبراءات المعينة متاحة، مع قواعدها الخاصة.

segments.src: ## Who is most affected
segments.tr: ## من هم الأكثر تأثراً

segments.src: - **Recent graduates** entering repayment for the first time and choosing between RAP and a standard schedule.
segments.tr: - **الخريجون الجدد** الذين يدخلون مرحلة السداد للمرة الأولى ويختارون بين خطة RAP والجدول الزمني القياسي.

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.
segments.tr: - **المقترضون في خطة SAVE** الذين كانوا في فترة سماح ويحتاجون الآن إلى خطة جديدة.

segments.src: - **Graduate and professional students** planning how to pay for programs under the new caps.
segments.tr: - **طلاب الدراسات العليا والمهنية** الذين يخططون لكيفية دفع تكاليف البرامج في ظل الحدود الجديدة.

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **الآباء** الذين يقترضون من خلال Parent PLUS، والذين يواجهون حدوداً سنوية وإجمالية جديدة.

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **الأسر التي لديها عدة معالين**، حيث قد يكون تخفيض الدفع لكل طفل مهمًا.

segments.src: ## What to check on your servicer account
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب التحقق منه في حساب جهة خدمة القروض الخاصة بك

segments.src: A short checklist you can do in about 20 minutes:
segments.tr: قائمة تحقق قصيرة يمكنك القيام بها في حوالي 20 دقيقة:

segments.src: 1. **Log in at StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances and interest rates.
segments.tr: 1. **سجل الدخول على StudentAid.gov** وتأكد من أنواع القروض والأرصدة ومعدلات الفائدة الخاصة بك.

segments.src: 2. **Identify your current repayment plan** and whether your servicer says it is changing.
segments.tr: 2. **حدد خطة السداد الحالية الخاصة بك** وما إذا كانت جهة خدمة القروض تقول إنها تتغير.

segments.src: 3. **Check your contact details.** Notices about plan changes often go out by email, and missed messages are a common cause of unexpected bills.
segments.tr: 3. **تحقق من تفاصيل الاتصال الخاصة بك.** غالباً ما يتم إرسال الإشعارات حول تغييرات الخطط عبر البريد الإلكتروني، والرسائل الفائتة هي سبب شائع للفواتير غير المتوقعة.

segments.src: 4. **Run the Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated monthly payment under each plan available to you.
segments.tr: 4. **قم بتشغيل محاكي القروض** لمقارنة دفعتك الشهرية المقدرة بموجب كل خططة متاحة لك.

segments.src: 5. **Review your income certification date.** Income-driven plans require annual recertification, and a late filing can raise your payment.
segments.tr: 5. **راجع تاريخ شهادة الدخل الخاصة بك.** تتطلب الخطط المستندة إلى الدخل إعادة إصدار الشهادات سنوياً، ويمكن أن يؤدي التأخر في التقديم إلى زيادة دفعتك.

segments.src: 6. **Confirm your due date and autopay.** A plan change can reset the bill date and may affect an autopay discount.
segments.tr: 6. **تأكد من تاريخ استحقاقك والدفع التلقائي.** يمكن أن يؤدي تغيير الخطة إلى إعادة ضبط تاريخ الفاتورة وقد يؤثر على خصم الدفع التلقائي.

segments.src: 7. **Look at your PSLF count**, if applicable, in the employment certification tool.
segments.tr: 7. **انظر إلى عداد PSLF الخاص بك**، إن أمكن، في أداة شهادة توظيف جهة العمل.

segments.src: 8. **Save records.** Keep screenshots or downloads of balances, payment counts and correspondence.
segments.tr: 8. **احفظ السجلات.** احتفظ بلقطات شاشة أو تنزيلات للأرصدة، وعدادات الدفع، والمراسلات.

segments.src: If anything looks wrong, contact your servicer in writing and keep a copy.
segments.tr: إذا بدا أي شيء خاطئاً، اتصل بجهة خدمة القروض كتابةً واحتفظ بنسخة.

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## الآثار المرتدة على ميزانيات الأسر

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: الدفعة الشهرية المختلفة تؤثر على أكثر من القرض نفسه.

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **تدفق النقود.** يمكن للدفعة الأقل أن توفر أموالاً للإيجار، أو رعاية الأطفال، أو مدخرات الطوارئ. قد تجبرك الدفعة الأعلى على تقديم تنازلات في مكان آخر.

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **إمكانية التنبؤ.** تتحرك الفواتير القائمة على الدخل مع تغير إجمالي الدخل المعدل (AGI)، مما يجعل وضع الميزانية أقل استقراراً للأشخاص ذوي الدخل المتغير. بناء احتياطي صغير يساعد.

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **الفائدة والرصيد.** دفع أقل من الفائدة المتراكمة يمكن أن يتسبب في نمو الأرصدة بموجب بعض الخطط. تم تصميم إعفاء الفائدة ومطابقة أصل القرض في خطة RAP للحد من ذلك، لكن قارن الأرقام.

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **المشتريات الكبيرة.** ينظر المقرضون إلى نسبة الدين إلى الدخل. الدفعة التي ترتفع أو تنخفض يمكن أن تغير حجم قرض الرهن العقاري أو قرض السيارة الذي تأهلت له.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **الضرائب.** أي إعفاء خاضع للضريبة في المستقبل هو سبب لنمذجة التكاليف طويلة الأجل، وليس فقط فاتورة الشهر القادم.

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## الآثار الائتمانية

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: يتم الإبلاغ عن قروض الطلاب الفدرالية إلى مكاتب الائتمان، لذا فإن سلوك السداد مهم.

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **المدفوعات في مواعيدها** تساعد سجلك. تغيير الخطط لا يضر بحد ذاته الائتمان الخاص بك عندما يتم إجراء المدفوعات كما تم فوترتها.

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **المدفوعات الفائتة** يمكن الإبلاغ عنها بعد مرور 90 يوماً على استحقاقها، ويحمل التخلف عن السداد عواقب وخيمة، بما في ذلك إجراءات التحصيل مثل الحجز على الأجور وتعويض استرداد الضرائب، والتي استأنفت بعد توقف الوباء.

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **فترات السماح وتأجيل السداد** لا تظهر عموماً كمدفوعات متأخرة، ولكن قد تستمر الفائدة في التراكم.

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **الفترات الانتقالية** محفوفة بالمخاطر. إذا انتقلت بين الخطط وكانت جهة خدمة القروض بطيئة، فتأكد من المبلغ الجديد وتاريخ الاستحقاق قبل استحقاق الفاتورة الأولى.

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: إذا لم تتمكن من تحمل دفعك، اتصل بجهة خدمة القروض قبل تفويت دفعة واحدة.

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: قد تكون الخيارات مثل خطة الدفع الأقل، أو تأجيل السداد، أو فترة السماح متاحة.

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## نصائح التخطيط

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - قارن الخطط باستخدام التكلفة الإجمالية بمرور الوقت، وليس فقط فاتورة السنة الأولى.

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - أعد إصدار شهادة الدخل في موعدها كل عام.

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - احذر من الشركات التي تتقاضى رسوماً مقابل المساعدة التي يمكنك الحصول عليها مجاناً من جهة خدمة القروض أو StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - إذا كنت لا تزال في المدرسة، اقترض فقط ما تحتاجه وتعرف على الحدود الخاصة ببرنامجك.

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - أعد زيارة خطتك عندما يتغير دخلك، أو حجم عائلتك، أو جهة عملك.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: تمنح إعادة ضبط قروض الطلاب بعض المقترضين مدفوعات أقل وأكثر قابلية للتنبؤ وتمنح آخرين سبباً لإعادة حساب الأرقام.

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.
segments.tr: الشيء الأكثر فائدة الذي يمكنك القيام به الآن هو النظر إلى حسابك الخاص، وفهم الخطة التي أنت عليها ومدى توفرها، ومقارنة الخيارات قبل أن يقرر الموعد النهائي نيابة عنك.

segments.src: Because the rules are still being implemented, rely on official sources for current details.
segments.tr: نظراً لأنه لا يزال يتم تنفيذ القواعد، اعتمد على المصادر الرسمية للحصول على التفاصيل الحالية.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial, tax or legal advice.*
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة للمعلومات العامة فقط ولا تشكل نصيحة مالية أو ضريبية أو قانونية.*

fr.title: La réinitialisation des prêts étudiants : comment les nouvelles règles de remboursement modifient les factures mensuelles de millions d'emprunteurs

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: Le remboursement des prêts étudiants fédéraux connaît sa plus grande refonte depuis des années.

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: Le Congrès a modifié les règles dans la loi de réconciliation budgétaire de 2025, et le ministère de l'Éducation met en œuvre ces changements progressivement.

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: Les nouveaux plans de remboursement, les nouvelles limites d'emprunt et la réduction des options basées sur le revenu signifient que le montant que de nombreux diplômés doivent chaque mois peut différer de ce qu'ils avaient prévu.

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique qui est concerné, ce qu'il faut vérifier dans votre compte de gestionnaire de prêt, et comment les changements pourraient affecter les budgets des ménages et le crédit.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils financiers ou juridiques.

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: Les délais et les détails peuvent changer avec les nouvelles réglementations et décisions de justice, alors confirmez les spécificités sur StudentAid.gov ou auprès de votre gestionnaire.

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## La situation globale

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: Trois changements sont les plus importants :

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **Un nouveau plan basé sur le revenu.** Le plan d'aide au remboursement (RAP) est disponible pour les emprunteurs à partir du 1er juillet 2026.

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Un ensemble de plans plus restreint au fil du temps.** Plusieurs plans existants basés sur le revenu sont progressivement supprimés.

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **De nouveaux plafonds d'emprunt.** Les limites sur le montant que les étudiants et les parents peuvent emprunter s'appliquent aux nouveaux prêts contractés à partir du 1er juillet 2026.

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## Le plan d'aide au remboursement (RAP)

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: Le RAP lie votre paiement mensuel à votre revenu brut ajusté (AGI) au lieu d'une part du revenu discrétionnaire.

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: Basé sur la structure publiée de la loi :

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - Les paiements varient d'environ 1 % à 10 % de l'AGI, augmentant à mesure que le revenu augmente.

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - Il y a un paiement mensuel minimum de $10.

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - Le paiement est réduit de $50 par mois pour chaque enfant à charge.

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - Si votre paiement ne couvre pas les intérêts mensuels, les intérêts impayés sont annulés. De plus, le plan correspond à une réduction du principal, jusqu'à $50 par mois, lorsque votre paiement est faible.

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - Les soldes restants peuvent être annulés après 30 ans de paiements admissibles.

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux emprunteurs à revenu faible ou moyen, le RAP peut produire une facture plus basse ou plus prévisible qu'un échéancier standard.

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: Les revenus plus élevés peuvent payer plus qu'ils ne le feraient dans le cadre de certains anciens plans basés sur le revenu.

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: Parce que la formule utilise l'AGI total, elle peut se comporter différemment des plans auxquels vous êtes peut-être habitué.

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: Utilisez le simulateur de prêt officiel plutôt que de deviner.

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## Qu'advient-il des anciens plans

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: Les plans qui existaient avant le changement suivent des calendriers différents :

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE.** Ce plan a été bloqué par des litiges et de nombreux emprunteurs inscrits ont été placés en report de paiement. En vertu de la nouvelle loi, il est en cours de suppression. Si vous étiez dans SAVE, surveillez les avis concernant le choix d'un nouveau plan.

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYE et ICR.** Ceux-ci sont destinés à être fermés aux nouvelles inscriptions, et la loi fixe une date limite au 1er juillet 2028 pour que les emprunteurs actuels passent à un autre plan. Les emprunteurs qui ne choisissent pas peuvent être placés dans un plan par le ministère.

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR.** Le remboursement basé sur le revenu (Income-Based Repayment) reste disponible pour les emprunteurs existants, ce qui en fait une option importante pour les personnes quittant d'autres plans.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **Remboursement standard.** Les nouveaux prêts contractés après le 1er juillet 2026 devraient avoir un plan standard avec une durée qui varie selon le solde, ainsi que le RAP.

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: Vérifiez quel plan votre gestionnaire affiche aujourd'hui, puis comparez-le avec ce à quoi vous serez éligible.

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: Changer de plan peut modifier à la fois votre facture mensuelle et le nombre d'années avant l'annulation.

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## Nouvelles limites d'emprunt

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: Pour les nouveaux prêts décaissés le ou après le 1er juillet 2026, les principales limites sont :

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Type d'emprunteur | Limite annuelle | Limite globale |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Étudiants diplômés | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Étudiants en profession libérale (comme le droit ou la médecine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | Parent PLUS (par étudiant) | $20,000 | $65,000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: Il existe également un plafond à vie de $257,500 sur les emprunts fédéraux par personne (à l'exclusion des prêts Parent PLUS).

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Les prêts Grad PLUS ne sont plus disponibles pour les nouveaux emprunteurs.

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: Les étudiants déjà inscrits et empruntant avant la date limite peuvent bénéficier d'une période de transition de quelques années, alors vérifiez comment votre propre situation est traitée.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: Les étudiants qui ont besoin de plus que ce que permettent les plafonds peuvent se tourner vers des prêts privés, qui manquent généralement de remboursement basé sur le revenu, d'options d'annulation ou des mêmes protections en cas de difficulté.

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: Ce compromis mérite d'être pesé avant d'emprunter.

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## Chemins vers l'annulation

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** Le PSLF reste en place pour les emprunteurs travaillant pour des employeurs gouvernementaux et à but non lucratif admissibles, généralement après 120 paiements admissibles. Les paiements effectués dans le cadre du RAP devraient être comptabilisés. Gardez votre certification d'employeur à jour.

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **Annulation basée sur le revenu.** Les soldes restants après la durée du plan (20 à 30 ans selon le plan) peuvent être annulés. À partir de 2026, les montants annulés dans le cadre de ces plans sont généralement traités à nouveau comme un revenu imposable au niveau fédéral, sauf exception. Prévoyez cette possibilité plutôt que de supposer que le solde disparaît simplement.

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **Libérations.** Les libérations pour invalidité totale et permanente et certaines autres restent disponibles, avec leurs propres règles.

segments.src: ## Who is most affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est le plus touché

segments.src: - **Recent graduates** entering repayment for the first time and choosing between RAP and a standard schedule.
segments.tr: - **Diplômés récents** entrant dans le remboursement pour la première fois et choisissant entre le RAP et un échéancier standard.

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.
segments.tr: - **Emprunteurs dans SAVE** qui ont été en report de paiement et ont maintenant besoin d'un nouveau plan.

segments.src: - **Graduate and professional students** planning how to pay for programs under the new caps.
segments.tr: - **Étudiants diplômés et professionnels** planifiant comment payer leurs programmes sous les nouveaux plafonds.

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **Parents** empruntant via Parent PLUS, qui font face à de nouvelles limites annuelles et totales.

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **Ménages avec plusieurs personnes à charge**, où la réduction de paiement par enfant peut avoir de l'importance.

segments.src: ## What to check on your servicer account
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut vérifier sur votre compte de gestionnaire

segments.src: A short checklist you can do in about 20 minutes:
segments.tr: Une courte liste de contrôle que vous pouvez faire en environ 20 minutes :

segments.src: 1. **Log in at StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances and interest rates.
segments.tr: 1. **Connectez-vous sur StudentAid.gov** et confirmez vos types de prêts, soldes et taux d'intérêt.

segments.src: 2. **Identify your current repayment plan** and whether your servicer says it is changing.
segments.tr: 2. **Identifiez votre plan de remboursement actuel** et si votre gestionnaire indique qu'il change.

segments.src: 3. **Check your contact details.** Notices about plan changes often go out by email, and missed messages are a common cause of unexpected bills.
segments.tr: 3. **Vérifiez vos coordonnées.** Les avis concernant les changements de plan sont souvent envoyés par e-mail, et les messages manqués sont une cause fréquente de factures inattendues.

segments.src: 4. **Run the Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated monthly payment under each plan available to you.
segments.tr: 4. **Exécutez le simulateur de prêt** pour comparer votre paiement mensuel estimé sous chaque plan disponible pour vous.

segments.src: 5. **Review your income certification date.** Income-driven plans require annual recertification, and a late filing can raise your payment.
segments.tr: 5. **Vérifiez votre date de certification de revenu.** Les plans basés sur le revenu nécessitent une recertification annuelle, et un dépôt tardif peut augmenter votre paiement.

segments.src: 6. **Confirm your due date and autopay.** A plan change can reset the bill date and may affect an autopay discount.
segments.tr: 6. **Confirmez votre date d'échéance et le paiement automatique.** Un changement de plan peut réinitialiser la date de facturation et peut affecter une réduction pour paiement automatique.

segments.src: 7. **Look at your PSLF count**, if applicable, in the employment certification tool.
segments.tr: 7. **Regardez votre décompte PSLF**, le cas échéant, dans l'outil de certification d'emploi.

segments.src: 8. **Save records.** Keep screenshots or downloads of balances, payment counts and correspondence.
segments.tr: 8. **Enregistrez les documents.** Gardez des captures d'écran ou des téléchargements des soldes, des décomptes de paiement et de la correspondance.

segments.src: If anything looks wrong, contact your servicer in writing and keep a copy.
segments.tr: Si quelque chose semble incorrect, contactez votre gestionnaire par écrit et gardez une copie.

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## Effets d'entraînement sur les budgets des ménages

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: Un paiement mensuel différent affecte plus que le prêt lui-même.

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Flux de trésorerie.** Un paiement plus bas peut libérer de l'argent pour le loyer, la garde d'enfants ou l'épargne d'urgence. Un paiement plus élevé peut forcer des compromis ailleurs.

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **Prévisibilité.** Les factures basées sur le revenu bougent à mesure que votre AGI change, ce qui rend la budgétisation moins stable pour les personnes ayant un revenu variable. Constituer un petit tampon aide.

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Intérêts et solde.** Payer moins que les intérêts courus peut entraîner une augmentation des soldes dans certains plans. L'annulation des intérêts et la correspondance du principal du RAP sont conçues pour limiter cela, mais comparez les chiffres.

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **Gros achats.** Les prêteurs examinent le ratio dette/revenu. Un paiement qui augmente ou diminue peut changer le montant du prêt hypothécaire ou automobile auquel vous êtes éligible.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **Impôts.** Toute future annulation imposable est une raison de modéliser les coûts à long terme, pas seulement la facture du mois prochain.

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## Implications pour le crédit

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: Les prêts étudiants fédéraux sont signalés aux agences d'évaluation du crédit, donc le comportement de remboursement compte.

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **Les paiements à temps** aident votre historique. Changer de plan ne nuit pas en soi à votre crédit lorsque les paiements sont effectués comme facturé.

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **Les paiements manqués** peuvent être signalés après 90 jours de retard, et un défaut de paiement entraîne de graves conséquences, y compris des actions de recouvrement telles que la saisie sur salaire et la compensation des remboursements d'impôts, qui ont repris après la pause de la pandémie.

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **Le report de paiement et le différé** n'apparaissent généralement pas comme des paiements en retard, mais les intérêts peuvent continuer à s'accumuler.

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **Les périodes de transition** sont risquées. Si vous changez de plan et que votre gestionnaire est lent, confirmez le nouveau montant et la date d'échéance avant que la première facture ne soit due.

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer votre mensualité, contactez votre gestionnaire avant d'en manquer une.

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: Des options telles qu'un plan de paiement plus bas, un différé ou un report de paiement peuvent être disponibles.

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## Conseils de planification

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - Comparez les plans en utilisant le coût total au fil du temps, pas seulement la facture de la première année.

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - Recertifiez vos revenus à temps chaque année.

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - Méfiez-vous des entreprises qui facturent des frais pour une aide que vous pouvez obtenir gratuitement auprès de votre gestionnaire ou de StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - Si vous êtes encore à l'école, n'empruntez que ce dont vous avez besoin et apprenez les plafonds pour votre programme.

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - Revoyez votre plan lorsque vos revenus, la taille de votre famille ou votre employeur changent.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: La réinitialisation des prêts étudiants offre à certains emprunteurs des paiements plus bas et plus prévisibles et donne à d'autres une raison de refaire les calculs.

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.
segments.tr: La chose la plus utile que vous puissiez faire maintenant est de regarder votre propre compte, de comprendre quel plan vous utilisez et combien de temps il sera disponible, et de comparer les options avant qu'une date limite ne décide pour vous.

segments.tr: Parce que les règles sont encore en cours de mise en œuvre, fiez-vous aux sources officielles pour les détails actuels.

pt.title: O Ajuste dos Empréstimos Estudantis: Como as Novas Regras de Reembolso Estão Mudando as Contas Mensais de Milhões de Mutuários

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: O reembolso de empréstimos estudantis federais está passando pela sua maior reformulação em anos.

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: O Congresso alterou as regras na lei de reconciliação orçamentária de 2025, e o Departamento de Educação está implementando essas mudanças gradualmente.

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: Novos planos de reembolso, novos limites de empréstimo e uma lista reduzida de opções baseadas na renda significam que o valor que muitos graduados devem pagar a cada mês pode ser diferente do que planejaram.

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: Este guia aborda quem é afetado, o que verificar na sua conta de administrador de empréstimos e como as mudanças podem impactar os orçamentos familiares e o crédito.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informações gerais, não de aconselhamento financeiro ou jurídico.

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: Cronogramas e detalhes podem mudar com novos regulamentos e decisões judiciais, portanto, confirme as especificidades em StudentAid.gov ou com seu administrador.

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## O panorama geral

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: Três mudanças são as mais importantes:

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **Um novo plano baseado na renda.** O Plano de Assistência ao Reembolso (RAP) está disponível para mutuários a partir de 1º de julho de 2026.

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Um conjunto menor de planos ao longo do tempo.** Vários planos existentes baseados na renda estão sendo eliminados gradualmente.

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **Novos limites de empréstimo.** Limites sobre quanto estudantes e pais podem tomar emprestado aplicam-se a novos empréstimos feitos em ou após 1º de julho de 2026.

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## O Plano de Assistência ao Reembolso (RAP)

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: O RAP vincula seu pagamento mensal à sua renda bruta ajustada (AGI) em vez de uma parcela da renda discricionária.

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: Com base na estrutura publicada da lei:

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - Os pagamentos variam de aproximadamente 1% a 10% da AGI, aumentando conforme a renda aumenta.

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - Há um pagamento mensal mínimo de $10.

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - O pagamento é reduzido em $50 por mês para cada filho dependente.

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - Se o seu pagamento não cobrir os juros mensais, os juros não pagos são dispensados. Além disso, o plano iguala a redução do principal, até $50 por mês, quando seu pagamento é pequeno.

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - Saldos remanescentes podem ser perdoados após 30 anos de pagamentos qualificáveis.

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: Para muitos mutuários de baixa e média renda, o RAP pode gerar uma conta menor ou mais previsível do que um cronograma padrão.

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: Quem ganha mais pode pagar mais do que pagaria sob alguns planos mais antigos baseados na renda.

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: Como a fórmula usa a AGI total, ela pode se comportar de maneira diferente dos planos aos quais você pode estar acostumado.

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: Use o Simulador de Empréstimo oficial em vez de adivinhar.

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## O que acontece com os planos antigos

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: Planos que existiam antes da mudança estão em cronogramas diferentes:

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE.** Este plano esteve envolvido em litígios e muitos mutuários inscritos foram colocados em tolerância (forbearance). Sob a nova lei, ele está sendo encerrado. Se você estava no SAVE, fique atento aos avisos sobre a escolha de um novo plano.

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYE e ICR.** Estes estão programados para fechar para novas inscrições, e a lei estabelece um prazo de 1º de julho de 2028 para que os mutuários atuais mudem para outro plano. Mutuários que não escolherem podem ser colocados em um plano pelo Departamento.

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR.** O Reembolso Baseado na Renda (IBR) permanece disponível para mutuários existentes, o que o torna uma opção importante para pessoas que estão saindo de outros planos.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **Reembolso padrão.** Espera-se que novos empréstimos feitos após 1º de julho de 2026 tenham um plano padrão com um prazo que varia de acordo com o saldo, além do RAP.

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: Verifique qual plano seu administrador mostra hoje, depois compare-o com o que você será elegível.

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: Mudar de plano pode alterar tanto sua conta mensal quanto o número de anos até o perdão da dívida.

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## Novos limites de empréstimo

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: Para novos empréstimos desembolsados em ou após 1º de julho de 2026, os principais limites são:

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Tipo de mutuário | Limite anual | Limite agregado |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Estudantes de pós-graduação | $20.500 | $100.000 |

segments.src: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Estudantes profissionais (como direito ou medicina) | $50.000 | $200.000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | Parent PLUS (por estudante) | $20.000 | $65.000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: Há também um limite vitalício de $257.500 em empréstimos federais por pessoa (excluindo empréstimos Parent PLUS).

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Empréstimos Grad PLUS não estão mais disponíveis para novos mutuários.

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: Estudantes já matriculados e tomando empréstimos antes do corte podem ter um período de transição de alguns anos, portanto, verifique como sua própria situação é tratada.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: Estudantes que precisam de mais do que os limites permitem podem recorrer a empréstimos privados, que geralmente carecem de reembolso baseado na renda, opções de perdão ou as mesmas proteções contra dificuldades financeiras.

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: Vale a pena ponderar essa troca antes de tomar o empréstimo.

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## Caminhos para o perdão da dívida

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **Perdão de Empréstimo por Serviço Público (PSLF).** O PSLF permanece em vigor para mutuários que trabalham para empregadores governamentais e sem fins lucrativos qualificados, geralmente após 120 pagamentos qualificáveis. Espera-se que os pagamentos sob o RAP contem. Mantenha sua certificação de empregador atualizada.

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **Perdão baseado na renda.** Saldos remanescentes após o prazo do plano (20 a 30 anos, dependendo do plano) podem ser perdoados. A partir de 2026, os valores perdoados sob esses planos geralmente são tratados como renda tributável novamente em nível federal, a menos que uma exceção se aplique. Planeje-se para essa possibilidade em vez de presumir que o saldo simplesmente desaparece.

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **Descargas.** Descargas por invalidez total e permanente e outras específicas permanecem disponíveis, com suas próprias regras.

segments.tr: ## Quem é mais afetado

segments.tr: - **Recém-graduados** entrando no reembolso pela primeira vez e escolhendo entre o RAP e um cronograma padrão.

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.

segments.tr: - **Estudantes de pós-graduação e profissionais** planejando como pagar pelos programas sob os novos limites.

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **Pais** tomando empréstimos através do Parent PLUS, que enfrentam novos limites anuais e totais.

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **Famílias com vários dependentes**, onde a redução de pagamento por filho pode ser relevante.

segments.tr: ## O que verificar na sua conta de administrador

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## Efeitos cascata nos orçamentos familiares

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: Um pagamento mensal diferente afeta mais do que apenas o empréstimo em si.

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Fluxo de caixa.** Um pagamento menor pode liberar dinheiro para aluguel, creche ou economias de emergência. Um pagamento maior pode forçar compensações em outros lugares.

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **Previsibilidade.** Contas baseadas na renda mudam conforme sua AGI muda, o que torna o orçamento menos estável para pessoas com renda variável. Construir uma pequena reserva ajuda.

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Juros e saldo.** Pagar menos do que os juros acumulados pode fazer com que os saldos cresçam sob alguns planos. A dispensa de juros e a igualação do principal do RAP são projetadas para limitar isso, mas compare os números.

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **Grandes compras.** Os credores analisam a relação dívida/renda. Um pagamento que sobe ou desce pode mudar o valor do financiamento imobiliário ou de automóvel para o qual você se qualifica.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **Impostos.** Qualquer perdão tributável futuro é uma razão para modelar custos de longo prazo, não apenas a conta do próximo mês.

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## Implicações de crédito

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: Empréstimos estudantis federais são relatados aos birôs de crédito, portanto, o comportamento de reembolso é importante.

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **Pagamentos pontuais** ajudam seu histórico. Mudar de plano não prejudica seu crédito por si só quando os pagamentos são feitos conforme cobrado.

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **Pagamentos perdidos** podem ser relatados após 90 dias de atraso, e uma inadimplência acarreta consequências graves, incluindo ações de cobrança como penhora de salário e compensação de restituições de impostos, que foram retomadas após a pausa da pandemia.

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **Tolerância e diferimento** geralmente não aparecem como pagamentos atrasados, mas os juros podem continuar a acumular.

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **Períodos de transição** são arriscados. Se você mudar entre planos e seu administrador for lento, confirme o novo valor e a data de vencimento antes que a primeira conta vença.

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: Se você não puder pagar seu pagamento, entre em contato com seu administrador antes de perder um.

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: Opções como um plano de pagamento menor, um diferimento ou tolerância podem estar disponíveis.

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## Dicas de planejamento

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - Compare planos usando o custo total ao longo do tempo, não apenas a conta do primeiro ano.

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - Recertifique a renda a tempo todos os anos.

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - Cuidado com empresas que cobram taxas por ajuda que você pode obter gratuitamente do seu administrador ou em StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - Se você ainda estiver na escola, tome emprestado apenas o que precisa e aprenda os limites para o seu programa.

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - Revise seu plano quando sua renda, tamanho da família ou empregador mudarem.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: O ajuste dos empréstimos estudantis oferece a alguns mutuários pagamentos menores e mais previsíveis e dá a outros um motivo para refazer os cálculos.

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.
segments.tr: A coisa mais útil que você pode fazer agora é olhar para sua própria conta, entender em qual plano você está e por quanto tempo ele estará disponível, e comparar as opções antes que um prazo decida por você.

segments.tr: Como as regras ainda estão sendo implementadas, confie em fontes oficiais para detalhes atuais.
