segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais e não constitui aconselhamento financeiro, fiscal ou jurídico.*

in.title: Penyetelan Ulang Pinjaman Mahasiswa: Bagaimana Aturan Pembayaran Kembali yang Baru Mengubah Tagihan Bulanan bagi Jutaan Peminjam

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: Pembayaran kembali pinjaman mahasiswa federal sedang mengalami penulisan ulang terbesarnya dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: Kongres mengubah aturan dalam undang-undang rekonsiliasi anggaran 2025, dan Departemen Pendidikan sedang menerapkan perubahan tersebut secara bertahap.

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: Rencana pembayaran kembali yang baru, batas pinjaman baru, dan pilihan berbasis pendapatan yang semakin terbatas berarti jumlah yang harus dibayar banyak lulusan setiap bulan mungkin terlihat berbeda dari yang mereka rencanakan.

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: Panduan ini mencakup siapa yang terdampak, apa yang harus diperiksa di akun penyedia layanan pinjaman Anda, dan bagaimana perubahan tersebut dapat berdampak pada anggaran rumah tangga dan kredit.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau hukum.

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: Linimasa dan detail dapat berubah seiring dengan peraturan baru dan putusan pengadilan, jadi konfirmasikan secara spesifik di StudentAid.gov atau dengan penyedia layanan Anda.

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran besar

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: Tiga perubahan yang paling penting:

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **Rencana berbasis pendapatan baru.** Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) tersedia bagi peminjam mulai 1 Juli 2026.

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Kumpulan rencana yang lebih sedikit seiring waktu.** Beberapa rencana berbasis pendapatan yang ada saat ini sedang dihapus secara bertahap.

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **Batas pinjaman baru.** Batas jumlah yang dapat dipinjam oleh mahasiswa dan orang tua berlaku untuk pinjaman baru yang dibuat pada atau setelah 1 Juli 2026.

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: RAP mengaitkan pembayaran bulanan Anda dengan penghasilan kotor yang disesuaikan (AGI) Anda, bukan dengan bagian dari pendapatan diskresioner.

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: Berdasarkan struktur yang diterbitkan undang-undang:

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - Pembayaran berkisar antara sekitar 1% hingga 10% dari AGI, meningkat seiring dengan kenaikan penghasilan.

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - Terdapat pembayaran bulanan minimum sebesar $10.

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - Pembayaran dikurangi sebesar $50 per bulan untuk setiap anak tanggungan.

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - Jika pembayaran Anda tidak menutupi bunga bulanan, bunga yang belum dibayar akan dihapuskan. Selain itu, rencana ini menyamai pengurangan pokok, hingga $50 per bulan, ketika pembayaran Anda kecil.

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - Saldo yang tersisa dapat dihapuskan setelah 30 tahun pembayaran yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak peminjam berpenghasilan rendah dan menengah, RAP dapat menghasilkan tagihan yang lebih rendah atau lebih dapat diprediksi daripada jadwal standar.

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: Peminjam berpenghasilan lebih tinggi mungkin membayar lebih banyak daripada yang mereka bayarkan di bawah beberapa rencana berbasis pendapatan yang lebih lama.

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: Karena rumusnya menggunakan total AGI, cara kerjanya bisa berbeda dari rencana yang mungkin biasa Anda gunakan.

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: Gunakan Loan Simulator resmi daripada menebak-nebak.

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## Apa yang terjadi pada rencana lama

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: Rencana yang ada sebelum perubahan memiliki jadwal yang berbeda:

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE.** Rencana ini terikat dalam litigasi dan banyak peminjam yang terdaftar ditempatkan dalam penangguhan pembayaran (forbearance). Di bawah undang-undang baru, rencana ini sedang dihentikan secara bertahap. Jika Anda berada di SAVE, perhatikan pemberitahuan tentang memilih rencana baru.

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYE dan ICR.** Rencana ini dijadwalkan untuk ditutup bagi pendaftaran baru, dan undang-undang menetapkan tenggat waktu 1 Juli 2028 bagi peminjam saat ini untuk pindah ke rencana lain. Peminjam yang tidak memilih mungkin akan ditempatkan dalam suatu rencana oleh Departemen.

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment tetap tersedia bagi peminjam yang ada, yang menjadikannya pilihan penting bagi orang-orang yang meninggalkan rencana lain.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **Pembayaran kembali standar.** Pinjaman baru yang dibuat setelah 1 Juli 2026 diharapkan memiliki rencana standar dengan jangka waktu yang bervariasi berdasarkan saldo, serta RAP.

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: Periksa rencana mana yang ditampilkan oleh penyedia layanan Anda hari ini, lalu bandingkan dengan rencana yang memenuhi syarat untuk Anda.

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: Memindahkan rencana dapat mengubah tagihan bulanan Anda dan jumlah tahun hingga penghapusan.

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## Batas pinjaman baru

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: Untuk pinjaman baru yang dicairkan pada atau setelah 1 Juli 2026, batas utamanya adalah:

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Jenis peminjam | Batas tahunan | Batas agregat |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Mahasiswa pascasarjana | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Mahasiswa profesional (seperti hukum atau kedokteran) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | Parent PLUS (per mahasiswa) | $20,000 | $65,000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: Ada juga batas seumur hidup sebesar $257,500 untuk pinjaman federal per orang (tidak termasuk pinjaman Parent PLUS).

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Pinjaman Grad PLUS tidak lagi tersedia bagi peminjam baru.

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: Mahasiswa yang sudah terdaftar dan meminjam sebelum batas waktu mungkin memiliki masa transisi beberapa tahun, jadi periksa bagaimana situasi Anda diperlakukan.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: Mahasiswa yang membutuhkan lebih dari yang diizinkan oleh batas tersebut mungkin beralih ke pinjaman swasta, yang biasanya tidak memiliki pembayaran kembali berbasis pendapatan, opsi penghapusan, atau perlindungan kesulitan yang sama.

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: Pertukaran itu layak dipertimbangkan sebelum Anda meminjam.

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## Jalur penghapusan

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF tetap berlaku bagi peminjam yang bekerja untuk pemberi kerja pemerintah dan nirlaba yang memenuhi syarat, umumnya setelah 120 pembayaran yang memenuhi syarat. Pembayaran di bawah RAP diharapkan dapat dihitung. Pastikan sertifikasi pemberi kerja Anda tetap mutakhir.

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **Penghapusan berbasis pendapatan.** Saldo yang tersisa setelah jangka waktu rencana (20 hingga 30 tahun tergantung pada rencana) dapat dihapuskan. Mulai tahun 2026, jumlah yang dihapuskan di bawah rencana ini umumnya diperlakukan sebagai penghasilan kena pajak lagi di tingkat federal, kecuali jika ada pengecualian. Rencanakan kemungkinan itu daripada berasumsi saldo tersebut akan hilang begitu saja.

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **Pelepasan (Discharges).** Pelepasan karena cacat total dan permanen serta beberapa lainnya tetap tersedia, dengan aturannya masing-masing.

segments.src: ## Who is most affected
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang paling terdampak

segments.src: - **Recent graduates** entering repayment for the first time and choosing between RAP and a standard schedule.
segments.tr: - **Lulusan baru** yang memasuki masa pembayaran kembali untuk pertama kalinya dan memilih antara RAP dan jadwal standar.

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.
segments.tr: - **Peminjam di SAVE** yang telah berada dalam penangguhan pembayaran dan sekarang memerlukan rencana baru.

segments.src: - **Graduate and professional students** planning how to pay for programs under the new caps.
segments.tr: - **Mahasiswa pascasarjana dan profesional** yang merencanakan cara membayar program di bawah batas baru.

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **Orang tua** yang meminjam melalui Parent PLUS, yang menghadapi batas tahunan dan total yang baru.

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga dengan beberapa tanggungan**, di mana pengurangan pembayaran per anak mungkin penting.

segments.src: ## What to check on your servicer account
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperiksa di akun penyedia layanan Anda

segments.src: A short checklist you can do in about 20 minutes:
segments.tr: Daftar periksa singkat yang dapat Anda lakukan dalam waktu sekitar 20 menit:

segments.src: 1. **Log in at StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances and interest rates.
segments.tr: 1. **Masuk ke StudentAid.gov** dan konfirmasikan jenis pinjaman, saldo, dan suku bunga Anda.

segments.src: 2. **Identify your current repayment plan** and whether your servicer says it is changing.
segments.tr: 2. **Identifikasi rencana pembayaran kembali Anda saat ini** dan apakah penyedia layanan Anda mengatakan rencana tersebut berubah.

segments.src: 3. **Check your contact details.** Notices about plan changes often go out by email, and missed messages are a common cause of unexpected bills.
segments.tr: 3. **Periksa detail kontak Anda.** Pemberitahuan tentang perubahan rencana sering dikirim melalui email, dan pesan yang terlewat adalah penyebab umum tagihan tak terduga.

segments.src: 4. **Run the Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated monthly payment under each plan available to you.
segments.tr: 4. **Jalankan Loan Simulator** untuk membandingkan perkiraan pembayaran bulanan Anda di bawah setiap rencana yang tersedia bagi Anda.

segments.src: 5. **Review your income certification date.** Income-driven plans require annual recertification, and a late filing can raise your payment.
segments.tr: 5. **Tinjau tanggal sertifikasi penghasilan Anda.** Rencana berbasis pendapatan memerlukan sertifikasi ulang tahunan, dan pengajuan yang terlambat dapat menaikkan pembayaran Anda.

segments.src: 6. **Confirm your due date and autopay.** A plan change can reset the bill date and may affect an autopay discount.
segments.tr: 6. **Konfirmasikan tanggal jatuh tempo dan pembayaran otomatis (autopay) Anda.** Perubahan rencana dapat mengatur ulang tanggal tagihan dan dapat memengaruhi diskon pembayaran otomatis.

segments.src: 7. **Look at your PSLF count**, if applicable, in the employment certification tool.
segments.tr: 7. **Lihat jumlah PSLF Anda**, jika berlaku, di alat sertifikasi pekerjaan.

segments.src: 8. **Save records.** Keep screenshots or downloads of balances, payment counts and correspondence.
segments.tr: 8. **Simpan catatan.** Simpan tangkapan layar atau unduhan saldo, jumlah pembayaran, dan korespondensi.

segments.src: If anything looks wrong, contact your servicer in writing and keep a copy.
segments.tr: Jika ada yang terlihat salah, hubungi penyedia layanan Anda secara tertulis dan simpan salinannya.

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## Efek riak pada anggaran rumah tangga

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: Pembayaran bulanan yang berbeda memengaruhi lebih dari sekadar pinjaman itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Arus kas.** Pembayaran yang lebih rendah dapat membebaskan uang untuk sewa, penitipan anak, atau tabungan darurat. Pembayaran yang lebih tinggi mungkin memaksa adanya pertukaran di tempat lain.

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **Prediktabilitas.** Tagihan berbasis pendapatan berubah seiring perubahan AGI Anda, yang membuat penganggaran kurang stabil bagi orang dengan penghasilan variabel. Membangun penyangga kecil akan membantu.

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Bunga dan saldo.** Membayar kurang dari bunga yang terakumulasi dapat menyebabkan saldo membengkak di bawah beberapa rencana. Penghapusan bunga dan penyamaan pokok RAP dirancang untuk membatasi hal itu, tetapi bandingkan angkanya.

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **Pembelian besar.** Pemberi pinjaman melihat rasio utang terhadap pendapatan. Pembayaran yang naik atau turun dapat mengubah seberapa besar hipotek atau pinjaman mobil yang memenuhi syarat untuk Anda.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **Pajak.** Penghapusan kena pajak di masa depan adalah alasan untuk memodelkan biaya jangka panjang, bukan hanya tagihan bulan depan.

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## Implikasi kredit

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: Pinjaman mahasiswa federal dilaporkan ke biro kredit, jadi perilaku pembayaran kembali itu penting.

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **Pembayaran tepat waktu** membantu riwayat Anda. Beralih rencana dengan sendirinya tidak merusak kredit Anda jika pembayaran dilakukan sesuai tagihan.

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **Pembayaran yang terlewat** dapat dilaporkan setelah 90 hari lewat jatuh tempo, dan gagal bayar (default) membawa konsekuensi serius, termasuk tindakan penagihan seperti pemotongan gaji dan penggantian pengembalian pajak, yang telah dilanjutkan setelah jeda pandemi.

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **Penangguhan pembayaran (forbearance) dan penundaan (deferment) umumnya tidak muncul sebagai pembayaran terlambat, tetapi bunga mungkin terus bertambah.

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **Masa transisi** berisiko. Jika Anda berpindah antar rencana dan penyedia layanan Anda lambat, konfirmasikan jumlah dan tanggal jatuh tempo baru sebelum tagihan pertama jatuh tempo.

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: Jika Anda tidak mampu membayar, hubungi penyedia layanan Anda sebelum Anda melewatkan pembayaran.

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: Opsi seperti rencana pembayaran lebih rendah, penundaan, atau penangguhan pembayaran mungkin tersedia.

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## Kiat perencanaan

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan rencana menggunakan total biaya dari waktu ke waktu, bukan hanya tagihan tahun pertama.

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - Sertifikasi ulang penghasilan tepat waktu setiap tahun.

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - Waspadai perusahaan yang mengenakan biaya untuk bantuan yang bisa Anda dapatkan secara gratis dari penyedia layanan Anda atau StudentAid.gov.

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - Jika Anda masih bersekolah, pinjamlah hanya apa yang Anda butuhkan dan pelajari batas untuk program Anda.

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - Tinjau kembali rencana Anda saat penghasilan, ukuran keluarga, atau pemberi kerja Anda berubah.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: Penyetelan ulang pinjaman mahasiswa memberikan beberapa peminjam pembayaran yang lebih rendah dan lebih dapat diprediksi serta memberikan alasan bagi yang lain untuk menghitung ulang angka-angkanya.

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.
segments.tr: Hal paling berguna yang dapat Anda lakukan sekarang adalah melihat akun Anda sendiri, memahami rencana mana yang Anda gunakan dan berapa lama rencana itu akan tersedia, serta membandingkan opsi sebelum tenggat waktu memutuskan untuk Anda.

segments.src: Because the rules are still being implemented, rely on official sources for current details.
segments.tr: Karena aturan masih dalam tahap penerapan, andalkan sumber resmi untuk detail terkini.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and does not constitute financial, tax or legal advice.*
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan, pajak, atau hukum.*

ja.title: 学生ローンのリセット：新しい返済ルールが数百万人の借り手の月々の支払いに与える影響

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: 連邦学生ローンの返済は、ここ数年で最大の書き換えが行われています。

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: 議会は2025年の予算調整法でルールを変更し、教育省はその変更を段階的に実施しています。

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: 新しい返済プラン、新しい借入限度額、そして縮小する所得連動型返済オプションの選択肢により、多くの卒業生が毎月支払うべき金額は、当初の計画とは異なる可能性があります。

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: このガイドでは、誰が影響を受けるのか、ローンサービサーのアカウントで何を確認すべきか、そしてこれらの変更が家計や信用にどのような影響を与える可能性があるかを解説します。

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: これは一般的な情報であり、財務や法律に関するアドバイスではありません。

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: スケジュールや詳細は新しい規制や裁判所の判決によって変更される可能性があるため、具体的な内容は StudentAid.gov またはサービサーに確認してください。

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## 全体像

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: 特に重要な3つの変更点があります。

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **新しい所得連動型プラン。** 返済支援プラン（RAP）は、2026年7月1日から借り手が利用可能になります。

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **プランの縮小。** 既存の所得連動型プランのいくつかは段階的に廃止されます。

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **新しい借入上限。** 学生や保護者が借り入れできる金額の上限が、2026年7月1日以降に行われる新規ローンに適用されます。

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## 返済支援プラン（RAP）

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: RAPは、月々の支払額を裁量的所得の割合ではなく、調整後総所得（AGI）に連動させます。

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: 法律で公表されている仕組みに基づくと：

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - 支払額はAGIの概ね1%から10%の範囲で、所得の上昇に伴って増加します。

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - 月々の最低支払額は$10です。

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - 扶養する子供1人につき、月々の支払額が$50減額されます。

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - 支払額が月々の利息をカバーできない場合、未払利息は免除されます。さらに、支払額が少ない場合、プランは最大月$50まで元本の削減を補填します。

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - 残高は、適格な支払いを30年間行った後に免除される可能性があります。

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: 多くの低・中所得の借り手にとって、RAPは標準的な返済スケジュールよりも支払額が低くなるか、より予測しやすくなる可能性があります。

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: 高所得者は、古い所得連動型プランよりも支払額が多くなる可能性があります。

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: この計算式は総AGIを使用するため、慣れ親しんだプランとは異なる動きをする可能性があります。

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: 推測するのではなく、公式のローンシミュレーターを使用してください。

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## 古いプランはどうなるのか

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: 変更前に存在していたプランは、それぞれ異なる期限が設定されています：

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE。** このプランは訴訟に巻き込まれており、登録していた多くの借り手が支払い猶予（フォーベアランス）状態に置かれました。新法の下では、このプランは終了に向かっています。SAVEプランを利用していた場合は、新しいプランを選択するよう通知がないか確認してください。

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYEおよびICR。** これらは新規登録を終了する予定であり、法律により、現在の借り手が別のプランに移行するための期限が2028年7月1日に設定されています。選択しない借り手は、教育省によってプランを割り当てられる可能性があります。

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR。** 所得連動型返済（IBR）は既存の借り手に対して引き続き利用可能であり、他のプランから移行する人々にとって重要な選択肢となります。

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **標準返済。** 2026年7月1日以降の新規ローンには、残高に応じて期間が異なる標準プランと、RAPが適用される見込みです。

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: 現在サービサーが提示しているプランを確認し、自分が利用資格を持つプランと比較してください。

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: プランを変更すると、月々の支払額と免除までの年数の両方が変わる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## 新しい借入限度額

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: 2026年7月1日以降に実行される新規ローンについて、主な限度額は以下の通りです：

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | 借り手のタイプ | 年間限度額 | 合計限度額 |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
| Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | 専門職大学院生（法科大学院や医学部など） | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | 親向けPLUSローン（学生1人につき） | $20,000 | $65,000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: また、一人あたりの連邦借入額には生涯上限$257,500が設定されています（親向けPLUSローンを除く）。

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: 大学院向けPLUSローンは、新規の借り手には利用できなくなります。

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: 期限前にすでに在学中で借り入れを行っている学生には数年間の移行期間が設けられる可能性があるため、自身の状況がどのように扱われるかを確認してください。

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: 上限を超える借入が必要な学生は民間ローンを利用する可能性がありますが、民間ローンには通常、所得連動型返済や免除オプション、同等の困難に対する保護措置がありません。

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: 借り入れを行う前に、そのトレードオフを検討する価値があります。

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## 免除への道

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **公的サービスローン免除（PSLF）。** PSLFは、適格な政府機関や非営利団体で働く借り手のために引き続き利用可能で、通常120回の適格な支払い後に免除されます。RAPに基づく支払いもカウントされる見込みです。雇用証明を最新の状態に保ってください。

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **所得連動型免除。** プランの期間（プランに応じて20〜30年）終了後に残っている残高は免除される可能性があります。2026年以降、これらのプランに基づく免除額は、例外が適用されない限り、連邦レベルで再び課税対象所得として扱われます。残高が単に消滅すると想定するのではなく、その可能性を考慮して計画を立ててください。

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **免責。** 完全かつ恒久的な障害による免責やその他の特定の免責は引き続き利用可能ですが、それぞれ独自のルールがあります。

segments.src: ## Who is most affected
segments.tr: ## 最も影響を受ける人々

segments.src: - **Recent graduates** entering repayment for the first time and choosing between RAP and a standard schedule.
segments.tr: - **最近卒業した学生。** 初めて返済を開始し、RAPと標準スケジュールの間で選択を行う人。

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVEプランを利用中の借り手。** 支払い猶予期間を経て、新しいプランが必要な人。

segments.src: - **Graduate and professional students** planning how to pay for programs under the new caps.
segments.tr: - **大学院生および専門職大学院生。** 新しい上限の下でプログラムの費用をどう支払うか計画している人。

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **保護者。** 親向けPLUSローンを利用しており、新しい年間および合計上限に直面している人。

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **複数の扶養家族を持つ世帯。** 子供1人あたりの支払減額が重要になる可能性がある人。

segments.src: ## What to check on your servicer account
segments.tr: ## サービサーのアカウントで確認すべきこと

segments.src: A short checklist you can do in about 20 minutes:
segments.tr: 約20分でできる簡単なチェックリスト：

segments.src: 1. **Log in at StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances and interest rates.
segments.tr: 1. **StudentAid.govにログインし**、ローンの種類、残高、金利を確認する。

segments.src: 2. **Identify your current repayment plan** and whether your servicer says it is changing.
segments.tr: 2. **現在の返済プランを特定し**、サービサーが変更を予定しているかどうかを確認する。

segments.src: 3. **Check your contact details.** Notices about plan changes often go out by email, and missed messages are a common cause of unexpected bills.
segments.tr: 3. **連絡先情報を確認する。** プラン変更に関する通知はメールで送られることが多く、メッセージの見落としは予期せぬ請求の一般的な原因です。

segments.src: 4. **Run the Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated monthly payment under each plan available to you.
segments.tr: 4. **ローンシミュレーターを実行し**、利用可能な各プランでの推定月額支払額を比較する。

segments.src: 5. **Review your income certification date.** Income-driven plans require annual recertification, and a late filing can raise your payment.
segments.tr: 5. **所得証明の期限を確認する。** 所得連動型プランは毎年再証明が必要であり、提出が遅れると支払額が上がる可能性があります。

segments.src: 6. **Confirm your due date and autopay.** A plan change can reset the bill date and may affect an autopay discount.
segments.tr: 6. **支払期日と自動引き落としを確認する。** プラン変更により支払日がリセットされ、自動引き落とし割引に影響する可能性があります。

segments.src: 7. **Look at your PSLF count**, if applicable, in the employment certification tool.
segments.tr: 7. **該当する場合は、雇用証明ツールでPSLFのカウントを確認する。**

segments.src: 8. **Save records.** Keep screenshots or downloads of balances, payment counts and correspondence.
segments.tr: 8. **記録を保存する。** 残高、支払い回数、やり取りのスクリーンショットやダウンロードを保管しておく。

segments.src: If anything looks wrong, contact your servicer in writing and keep a copy.
segments.tr: 何かおかしい点があれば、書面でサービサーに連絡し、コピーを保管してください。

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## 家計への波及効果

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: 月々の支払額の変化は、ローンそのもの以上の影響を与えます。

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **キャッシュフロー。** 支払額が減れば、家賃、保育費、緊急時の貯蓄に回せるお金が増える可能性があります。逆に増えれば、他の支出を削る必要が出てくるかもしれません。

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **予測可能性。** 所得連動型の支払額はAGIの変化に応じて変動するため、収入が不安定な人にとっては予算管理が難しくなります。少額のバッファ（余裕）を作っておくことが役立ちます。

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **利息と残高。** 発生した利息よりも少ない支払額だと、一部のプランでは残高が増加する可能性があります。RAPの利息免除と元本補填はその制限を目的としていますが、数字を比較してください。

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **大きな買い物。** 貸し手は負債所得比率を確認します。支払額が増減すると、住宅ローンや自動車ローンの審査結果に影響する可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **税金。** 将来的に免除額が課税対象となる可能性があるため、来月の支払いだけでなく、長期的なコストをモデル化する理由になります。

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## 信用への影響

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: 連邦学生ローンは信用調査機関に報告されるため、返済行動が重要です。

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **期日通りの支払い**は信用履歴にプラスになります。請求通りに支払っている限り、プランの切り替え自体が信用を傷つけることはありません。

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **支払いの遅延**は90日以上経過すると報告される可能性があり、債務不履行（デフォルト）は深刻な結果を招きます。これには、パンデミックの一時停止後に再開された、給与差し押さえや税還付の相殺などの回収措置が含まれます。

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **支払い猶予（フォーベアランスおよびディファーメント）**は通常、支払い遅延としては表示されませんが、利息は増え続ける可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **移行期間**はリスクを伴います。プラン間で移動する際、サービサーの対応が遅い場合は、最初の請求が来る前に新しい金額と支払期日を確認してください。

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: 支払いが困難な場合は、滞納する前にサービサーに連絡してください。

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: 支払額を減らすプランや、支払い猶予などの選択肢が利用できる場合があります。

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## 計画のためのヒント

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - 初年度の請求額だけでなく、期間全体の総コストでプランを比較してください。

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - 毎年、期限内に所得の再証明を行ってください。

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - サービサーやStudentAid.govから無料で受けられるサポートに対して手数料を請求する業者には注意してください。

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - まだ在学中の場合は、必要な分だけを借り、自分のプログラムの限度額を把握してください。

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - 所得、家族構成、雇用主に変化があった場合は、プランを見直してください。

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: 学生ローンのリセットにより、一部の借り手は支払額が減り、より予測しやすくなる一方、他の借り手にとっては数字を再計算するきっかけとなります。

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.

de.title: Der Studienkredit-Neustart: Wie neue Rückzahlungsregeln die monatlichen Rechnungen für Millionen Kreditnehmer verändern

segments.src: Federal student loan repayment is going through its biggest rewrite in years.
segments.tr: Die Rückzahlung von Bundesskrediten für Studierende durchläuft die größte Reform seit Jahren.

segments.src: Congress changed the rules in the 2025 budget reconciliation law, and the Department of Education is phasing those changes in.
segments.tr: Der Kongress hat die Regeln im Haushaltsabgleichsgesetz von 2025 geändert, und das Bildungsministerium setzt diese Änderungen schrittweise um.

segments.src: New repayment plans, new borrowing limits and a shrinking menu of income-driven options mean the amount many graduates owe each month may look different from what they planned.
segments.tr: Neue Rückzahlungspläne, neue Kreditlimits und ein schrumpfendes Angebot an einkommensabhängigen Optionen bedeuten, dass der Betrag, den viele Absolventen jeden Monat schulden, anders aussehen kann als von ihnen geplant.

segments.src: This guide covers who is affected, what to check in your loan servicer account, and how the changes could flow through to household budgets and credit.
segments.tr: Dieser Leitfaden behandelt, wer betroffen ist, was in Ihrem Konto beim Kreditdienstleister zu überprüfen ist und wie sich die Änderungen auf Haushaltsbudgets und Kreditwürdigkeit auswirken können.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial or legal advice.
segments.tr: Dies sind allgemeine Informationen, keine Finanz- oder Rechtsberatung.

segments.src: Timelines and details can shift with new regulations and court rulings, so confirm specifics at StudentAid.gov or with your servicer.
segments.tr: Zeitpläne und Details können sich durch neue Vorschriften und Gerichtsurteile ändern. Bestätigen Sie daher Einzelheiten auf StudentAid.gov oder bei Ihrem Dienstleister.

segments.src: ## The big picture
segments.tr: ## Das große Ganze

segments.src: Three shifts matter most:
segments.tr: Drei Veränderungen sind am wichtigsten:

segments.src: 1. **A new income-based plan.** The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) is available to borrowers starting July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 1. **Ein neuer einkommensbasierter Plan.** Der Rückzahlungsunterstützungsplan (RAP) steht Kreditnehmern ab dem 1. Juli 2026 zur Verfügung.

segments.src: 2. **A smaller set of plans over time.** Several existing income-driven plans are being phased out.
segments.tr: 2. **Ein kleinerer Satz von Plänen im Laufe der Zeit.** Mehrere bestehende einkommensabhängige Pläne werden schrittweise abgeschafft.

segments.src: 3. **New borrowing caps.** Limits on how much students and parents can borrow apply to new loans made on or after July 1, 2026.
segments.tr: 3. **Neue Kreditvergabekappen.** Obergrenzen dafür, wie viel Studenten und Eltern leihen können, gelten für neue Kredite, die am oder nach dem 1. Juli 2026 vergeben werden.

segments.src: ## The Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP)
segments.tr: ## Der Rückzahlungsunterstützungsplan (RAP)

segments.src: RAP ties your monthly payment to your adjusted gross income (AGI) instead of a share of discretionary income.
segments.tr: Der RAP knüpft Ihre monatliche Zahlung an Ihr bereinigtes Bruttoeinkommen (AGI) statt an einen Anteil des verfügbaren Einkommens.

segments.src: Based on the law's published structure:
segments.tr: Basierend auf der veröffentlichten Struktur des Gesetzes:

segments.src: - Payments range from roughly 1% to 10% of AGI, rising as income rises.
segments.tr: - Die Zahlungen reichen von etwa 1 % bis 10 % des AGI und steigen mit wachsendem Einkommen.

segments.src: - There is a minimum monthly payment of $10.
segments.tr: - Es gibt eine monatliche Mindestzahlung von $10.

segments.src: - The payment is reduced by $50 per month for each dependent child.
segments.tr: - Die Zahlung wird für jedes unterhaltsberechtigte Kind um $50 pro Monat reduziert.

segments.src: - If your payment doesn't cover the monthly interest, the unpaid interest is waived. In addition, the plan matches principal reduction, up to $50 a month, when your payment is small.
segments.tr: - Wenn Ihre Zahlung die monatlichen Zinsen nicht deckt, werden die unbezahlten Zinsen erlassen. Darüber hinaus gleicht der Plan die Tilgung des Kapitals bis zu $50 pro Monat an, wenn Ihre Zahlung gering ist.

segments.src: - Remaining balances may be forgiven after 30 years of qualifying payments.
segments.tr: - Verbleibende Salden können nach 30 Jahren qualifizierender Zahlungen erlassen werden.

segments.src: For many lower- and middle-income borrowers, RAP can produce a lower or more predictable bill than a standard schedule.
segments.tr: Für viele Kreditnehmer mit niedrigen und mittleren Einkommen kann der RAP eine geringere oder vorhersehbarere Rechnung als ein Standardplan ergeben.

segments.src: Higher earners may pay more than they would under some older income-driven plans.
segments.tr: Besserverdienende zahlen möglicherweise mehr als unter einigen älteren einkommensabhängigen Plänen.

segments.src: Because the formula uses total AGI, it can behave differently from plans you may be used to.
segments.tr: Da die Formel das gesamte AGI verwendet, kann sie sich anders verhalten als Pläne, an die Sie gewöhnt sind.

segments.src: Use the official Loan Simulator rather than guessing.
segments.tr: Verwenden Sie den offiziellen Darlehnssimulator, anstatt zu raten.

segments.src: ## What happens to older plans
segments.tr: ## Was mit älteren Plänen passiert

segments.src: Plans that existed before the change are on different clocks:
segments.tr: Pläne, die vor der Änderung existierten, laufen zu unterschiedlichen Zeiten aus:

segments.src: - **SAVE.** This plan has been tied up in litigation and many enrolled borrowers were placed in forbearance. Under the new law it is being wound down. If you were in SAVE, watch for notices about choosing a new plan.
segments.tr: - **SAVE.** Dieser Plan ist in Rechtsstreitigkeiten verwickelt, und viele eingeschriebene Kreditnehmer wurden in eine zinsfreie Stundung versetzt. Nach dem neuen Gesetz wird er abgewickelt. Wenn Sie bei SAVE waren, achten Sie auf Benachrichtigungen zur Auswahl eines neuen Plans.

segments.src: - **PAYE and ICR.** These are slated to close to new enrollment, and the law sets a deadline of July 1, 2028 for current borrowers to move to another plan. Borrowers who do not choose may be placed in a plan by the Department.
segments.tr: - **PAYE und ICR.** Diese sollen für neue Einschreibungen geschlossen werden, und das Gesetz setzt eine Frist bis zum 1. Juli 2028 für derzeitige Kreditnehmer, um in einen anderen Plan zu wechseln. Kreditnehmer, die sich nicht entscheiden, werden möglicherweise vom Ministerium in einen Plan eingeteilt.

segments.src: - **IBR.** Income-Based Repayment remains available to existing borrowers, which makes it an important option for people leaving other plans.
segments.tr: - **IBR.** Die einkommensbasierte Rückzahlung bleibt für bestehende Kreditnehmer verfügbar, was sie zu einer wichtigen Option für Personen macht, die andere Pläne verlassen.

segments.src: - **Standard repayment.** New loans made after July 1, 2026 are expected to have a standard plan with a term that varies by balance, as well as RAP.
segments.tr: - **Standardrückzahlung.** Für neue Kredite, die nach dem 1. Juli 2026 gewährt werden, wird neben dem RAP ein Standardplan mit einer je nach Saldo variierenden Laufzeit erwartet.

segments.src: Check which plan your servicer shows today, then compare it with what you will be eligible for.
segments.tr: Überprüfen Sie, welchen Plan Ihr Dienstleister heute anzeigt, und vergleichen Sie ihn mit dem, für den Sie berechtigt sein werden.

segments.src: Moving plans can change both your monthly bill and the number of years until forgiveness.
segments.tr: Das Wechseln von Plänen kann sowohl Ihre monatliche Rechnung als auch die Anzahl der Jahre bis zum Erlass ändern.

segments.src: ## New borrowing limits
segments.tr: ## Neue Kreditlimits

segments.src: For new loans disbursed on or after July 1, 2026, the main limits are:
segments.tr: Für neue Kredite, die am oder nach dem 1. Juli 2026 ausgezahlt werden, gelten folgende Hauptlimits:

segments.src: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |
segments.tr: | Borrower type | Annual limit | Aggregate limit |

segments.src: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |
segments.tr: | Graduate students | $20,500 | $100,000 |

segments.src: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |
segments.tr: | Professional students (such as law or medicine) | $50,000 | $200,000 |

segments.src: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |
segments.tr: | Parent PLUS (per student) | $20,000 | $65,000 |

segments.src: There is also a lifetime cap of $257,500 on federal borrowing per person (excluding Parent PLUS loans).
segments.tr: Es gibt auch eine lebenslange Obergrenze von $257,500 für Bundesskredite pro Person (ohne Parent-PLUS-Kredite).

segments.src: Grad PLUS loans are no longer available to new borrowers.
segments.tr: Grad-PLUS-Kredite stehen neuen Kreditnehmern nicht mehr zur Verfügung.

segments.src: Students already enrolled and borrowing before the cutoff may have a transition period of a few years, so check how your own situation is treated.
segments.tr: Studierende, die bereits vor dem Stichtag eingeschrieben waren und Kredite aufgenommen haben, haben möglicherweise eine Übergangszeit von einigen Jahren. Überprüfen Sie daher, wie Ihre eigene Situation behandelt wird.

segments.src: Students who need more than the caps allow may turn to private loans, which usually lack income-driven repayment, forgiveness options or the same hardship protections.
segments.tr: Studierende, die mehr benötigen, als die Obergrenzen erlauben, greifen möglicherweise auf Privatkredite zurück, bei denen in der Regel einkommensabhängige Rückzahlungen, Erlassoptionen oder dieselben Härtefallschutzmaßnahmen fehlen.

segments.src: That trade-off is worth weighing before you borrow.
segments.tr: Dieser Kompromiss sollte vor der Kreditaufnahme abgewogen werden.

segments.src: ## Forgiveness paths
segments.tr: ## Erlasswege

segments.src: - **Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).** PSLF remains in place for borrowers working for qualifying government and nonprofit employers, generally after 120 qualifying payments. Payments under RAP are expected to count. Keep your employer certification up to date.
segments.tr: - **Öffentlicher Dienst-Krediterlass (PSLF).** PSLF bleibt für Kreditnehmer bestehen, die für qualifizierende Regierungs- und gemeinnützige Arbeitgeber arbeiten, im Allgemeinen nach 120 qualifizierenden Zahlungen. Zahlungen im Rahmen des RAP werden voraussichtlich angerechnet. Halten Sie Ihre Arbeitgeberbescheinigung auf dem neuesten Stand.

segments.src: - **Income-driven forgiveness.** Balances remaining after the plan's term (20 to 30 years depending on plan) may be forgiven. Starting in 2026, forgiven amounts under these plans are generally treated as taxable income again at the federal level, unless an exception applies. Plan for that possibility rather than assuming the balance simply disappears.
segments.tr: - **Einkommensabhängiger Erlass.** Salden, die nach der Laufzeit des Plans (20 bis 30 Jahre je nach Plan) verbleiben, können erlassen werden. Ab 2026 werden erlassene Beträge im Rahmen dieser Pläne auf Bundesebene im Allgemeinen wieder als steuerpflichtiges Einkommen behandelt, es sei denn, es gilt eine Ausnahme. Planen Sie für diese Möglichkeit, anstatt anzunehmen, dass der Saldo einfach verschwindet.

segments.src: - **Discharges.** Total and permanent disability discharges and certain others remain available, with their own rules.
segments.tr: - **Restschuldbefreiungen.** Vollständige und dauerhafte Invaliditätsbefreiungen und bestimmte andere bleiben unter ihren eigenen Regeln verfügbar.

segments.src: ## Who is most affected
segments.tr: ## Wer ist am meisten betroffen

segments.src: - **Recent graduates** entering repayment for the first time and choosing between RAP and a standard schedule.
segments.tr: - **Frischgebackene Absolventen**, die zum ersten Mal in die Rückzahlung einsteigen und zwischen dem RAP und einem Standardplan wählen.

segments.src: - **Borrowers in SAVE** who have been in forbearance and now need a new plan.
segments.tr: - **Kreditnehmer bei SAVE**, die sich in einer Stundung befanden und nun einen neuen Plan benötigen.

segments.src: - **Graduate and professional students** planning how to pay for programs under the new caps.
segments.tr: - **Absolventen und Studierende von Graduiertenstudiengängen**, die planen, wie sie Programme unter den neuen Obergrenzen bezahlen.

segments.src: - **Parents** borrowing through Parent PLUS, who face new yearly and total limits.
segments.tr: - **Eltern**, die über Parent PLUS Kredite aufnehmen und mit neuen jährlichen und Gesamtlimits konfrontiert sind.

segments.src: - **Households with several dependents**, where the per-child payment reduction may matter.
segments.tr: - **Haushalte mit mehreren Unterhaltsberechtigten**, bei denen die Reduzierung der Zahlung pro Kind von Bedeutung sein kann.

segments.src: ## What to check on your servicer account
segments.tr: ## Was Sie auf dem Konto Ihres Dienstleisters überprüfen sollten

segments.src: A short checklist you can do in about 20 minutes:
segments.tr: Eine kurze Checkliste, die Sie in etwa 20 Minuten erledigen können:

segments.src: 1. **Log in at StudentAid.gov** and confirm your loan types, balances and interest rates.
segments.tr: 1. **Melden Sie sich auf StudentAid.gov an** und bestätigen Sie Ihre Kreditarten, Salden und Zinssätze.

segments.src: 2. **Identify your current repayment plan** and whether your servicer says it is changing.
segments.tr: 2. **Identifizieren Sie Ihren aktuellen Rückzahlungsplan** und ob Ihr Dienstleister angibt, dass er sich ändert.

segments.src: 3. **Check your contact details.** Notices about plan changes often go out by email, and missed messages are a common cause of unexpected bills.
segments.tr: 3. **Überprüfen Sie Ihre Kontaktdaten.** Benachrichtigungen über Planänderungen werden oft per E-Mail verschickt, und verpasste Nachrichten sind eine häufige Ursache für unerwartete Rechnungen.

segments.src: 4. **Run the Loan Simulator** to compare your estimated monthly payment under each plan available to you.
segments.tr: 4. **Führen Sie den Darlehnssimulator aus**, um Ihre geschätzte monatliche Zahlung im Rahmen jedes Ihnen zur Verfügung stehenden Plans zu vergleichen.

segments.src: 5. **Review your income certification date.** Income-driven plans require annual recertification, and a late filing can raise your payment.
segments.tr: 5. **Überprüfen Sie das Datum Ihrer Einkommensbescheinigung.** Einkommensabhängige Pläne erfordern eine jährliche Reaktivierung, und eine verspätete Einreichung kann Ihre Zahlung erhöhen.

segments.src: 6. **Confirm your due date and autopay.** A plan change can reset the bill date and may affect an autopay discount.
segments.tr: 6. **Bestätigen Sie Ihr Fälligkeitsdatum und den Lastschrifteinzug.** Eine Planänderung kann das Rechnungsdatum zurücksetzen und sich auf einen Lastschriftrabatt auswirken.

segments.src: 7. **Look at your PSLF count**, if applicable, in the employment certification tool.
segments.tr: 7. **Überprüfen Sie Ihre PSLF-Anzahl**, falls zutreffend, im Tool zur Beschäftigungsbescheinigung.

segments.src: 8. **Save records.** Keep screenshots or downloads of balances, payment counts and correspondence.
segments.tr: 8. **Speichern Sie Aufzeichnungen.** Bewahren Sie Screenshots oder Downloads von Salden, Zahlungszählungen und Korrespondenz auf.

segments.src: If anything looks wrong, contact your servicer in writing and keep a copy.
segments.tr: Wenn etwas falsch aussieht, kontaktieren Sie Ihren Dienstleister schriftlich und behalten Sie eine Kopie.

segments.src: ## Ripple effects on household budgets
segments.tr: ## Welleneffekte auf Haushaltsbudgets

segments.src: A different monthly payment affects more than the loan itself.
segments.tr: Eine andere monatliche Zahlung betrifft mehr als nur den Kredit selbst.

segments.src: - **Cash flow.** A lower payment can free up money for rent, childcare or emergency savings. A higher one may force tradeoffs elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Cashflow.** Eine geringere Zahlung kann Geld für Miete, Kinderbetreuung oder Notfallrücklagen freisetzen. Eine höhere kann Kompromisse anderswo erzwingen.

segments.src: - **Predictability.** Income-based bills move as your AGI changes, which makes budgeting less steady for people with variable pay. Building a small buffer helps.
segments.tr: - **Vorhersehbarkeit.** Einkommensbasierte Rechnungen bewegen sich mit der Änderung Ihres AGI, was die Budgetierung für Personen mit variablem Gehalt weniger stabil macht. Der Aufbau eines kleinen Puffers hilft.

segments.src: - **Interest and balance.** Paying less than the accrued interest can cause balances to grow under some plans. RAP's interest waiver and principal match are designed to limit that, but compare the numbers.
segments.tr: - **Zinsen und Saldo.** Weniger als die aufgelaufenen Zinsen zu zahlen, kann dazu führen, dass Salden unter einigen Plänen wachsen. Der Zinsverzicht und der Kapitalsatz des RAP sollen dies begrenzen, aber vergleichen Sie die Zahlen.

segments.src: - **Big purchases.** Lenders look at debt-to-income ratio. A payment that rises or falls can change how much mortgage or auto loan you qualify for.
segments.tr: - **Große Anschaffungen.** Kreditgeber betrachten das Verhältnis von Schulden zu Einkommen. Eine steigende oder fallende Zahlung kann ändern, für welche Hypothek oder welchen Autokredit Sie sich qualifizieren.

segments.src: - **Taxes.** Any future taxable forgiveness is a reason to model long-term costs, not only next month's bill.
segments.tr: - **Steuern.** Jede zukünftige steuerpflichtige Schuldenbefreiung ist ein Grund, langfristige Kosten zu modellieren, nicht nur die Rechnung des nächsten Monats.

segments.src: ## Credit implications
segments.tr: ## Auswirkungen auf die Kreditwürdigkeit

segments.src: Federal student loans are reported to credit bureaus, so repayment behavior matters.
segments.tr: Bundesskredite für Studierende werden an Kreditauskunfteien gemeldet, daher ist das Rückzahlungsverhalten wichtig.

segments.src: - **On-time payments** help your history. Switching plans does not by itself hurt your credit when payments are made as billed.
segments.tr: - **Pünktliche Zahlungen** helfen Ihrer Historie. Das Wechseln von Plänen schadet Ihrer Kreditwürdigkeit von sich aus nicht, wenn Zahlungen wie in Rechnung gestellt geleistet werden.

segments.src: - **Missed payments** can be reported after they are 90 days past due, and a default carries serious consequences, including collection actions such as wage garnishment and offset of tax refunds, which have resumed after the pandemic pause.
segments.tr: - **Verpasste Zahlungen** können gemeldet werden, nachdem sie 90 Tage überfällig sind, und ein Zahlungsausfall hat schwerwiegende Folgen, einschließlich Inkassomaßnahmen wie Lohnpfändung und Aufrechnung von Steuererstattungen, die nach der Pandemiepause wieder aufgenommen wurden.

segments.src: - **Forbearance and deferment** generally do not appear as late payments, but interest may continue to build.
segments.tr: - **Stundung und Aufschub** erscheinen im Allgemeinen nicht als verspätete Zahlungen, aber Zinsen können weiter anwachsen.

segments.src: - **Transition periods** are risky. If you move between plans and your servicer is slow, confirm the new amount and due date before the first bill is due.
segments.tr: - **Übergangszeiten** sind riskant. Wenn Sie zwischen Plänen wechseln und Ihr Dienstleister langsam ist, bestätigen Sie den neuen Betrag und das Fälligkeitsdatum, bevor die erste Rechnung fällig ist.

segments.src: If you cannot afford your payment, contact your servicer before you miss one.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie sich Ihre Zahlung nicht leisten können, kontaktieren Sie Ihren Dienstleister, bevor Sie eine verpassen.

segments.src: Options such as a lower-payment plan, a deferment or forbearance may be available.
segments.tr: Optionen wie ein Plan mit geringerer Zahlung, ein Aufschub oder eine Stundung stehen möglicherweise zur Verfügung.

segments.src: ## Planning tips
segments.tr: ## Planungstipps

segments.src: - Compare plans using total cost over time, not only the first year's bill.
segments.tr: - Vergleichen Sie Pläne anhand der Gesamtkosten im Laufe der Zeit, nicht nur nach der Rechnung des ersten Jahres.

segments.src: - Recertify income on time every year.
segments.tr: - Bescheinigen Sie Ihr Einkommen jedes Jahr pünktlich neu.

segments.src: - Beware of companies that charge fees for help you can get free from your servicer or StudentAid.gov.
segments.tr: - Hüten Sie sich vor Unternehmen, die Gebühren für Hilfe erheben, die Sie kostenlos von Ihrem Dienstleister oder StudentAid.gov erhalten können.

segments.src: - If you are still in school, borrow only what you need and learn the caps for your program.
segments.tr: - Wenn Sie noch in der Ausbildung sind, leihen Sie sich nur das aus, was Sie brauchen, und lernen Sie die Obergrenzen für Ihr Programm kennen.

segments.src: - Revisit your plan when your income, family size or employer changes.
segments.tr: - Überprüfen Sie Ihren Plan erneut, wenn sich Ihr Einkommen, Ihre Familiengröße oder Ihr Arbeitgeber ändert.

segments.src: ## Bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: The student loan reset gives some borrowers lower, more predictable payments and gives others a reason to re-run the numbers.
segments.tr: Der Studienkredit-Neustart gibt einigen Kreditnehmern niedrigere, vorhersehbarere Zahlungen und gibt anderen einen Grund, die Zahlen neu zu berechnen.

segments.src: The most useful thing you can do now is look at your own account, understand which plan you are on and how long it will be available, and compare the options before a deadline decides for you.
segments.tr: Das Nützlichste, was Sie jetzt tun können, ist, sich Ihr eigenes Konto anzusehen, zu verstehen, in welchem Plan Sie sich befinden und wie lange dieser verfügbar sein wird, und die Optionen zu vergleichen, bevor eine Frist für Sie entscheidet.

segments.tr: Da die Regeln noch umgesetzt werden, stützen Sie sich auf offizielle Quellen für aktuelle Details.

segments.tr: Đây là thông tin chung, không phải lời khuyên tài chính hay pháp lý.
